description: Marq is the Brand Enablement Platform for brand teams supporting creators across the organization. Connect Marq to ChatGPT to find brand templates and use them to create or update on-brand content like one-pagers, datasheets, and social posts. Use ChatGPT to inspect a project’s pages, text, images, and Smart Fields, then rewrite, proofread, or translate copy and replace images. You can also personalize content with user, team, or project information, populate documents from your Marq datasets, and apply Marq Brand Kit colors, fonts, and logos to supported template elements. Export finished projects as PDF, PNG, or JPG. Changes preserve existing styling and element locks, so teams can create and update content faster without losing brand or layout control. ChatGPT only works with content the signed-in user can access in Marq.

defaultPrompt: Create a one-page flyer for our fall product launch using one of our brand templates
Build a sales one-pager and fill in the customer details from our data
Update the headline and colors on my flyer to match our brand kit, then export it as a PDF
